name: Big Russian Boss SHOW
summary: The BRB Show is back!

previousepisode.name: Сабина Хайрова и Александр Волков. Новогодний выпуск

name: Lucy Worsley: Victorian Murder Club
summary: The Thames Torso Murderer terrorised 19th-century London but escaped justice. Lucy Worsley unearths this dark and dangerous story - can she unmask a forgotten serial killer?

name: Sweethearts
summary: Sweethearts is a light-hearted British panel game hosted by Larry Grayson, where a celebrity panel tries to spot the real couple hidden among a trio of hopeful storytellers. Each set of contestants shares the same "how we met" tale but only one is genuine, and the panel must quiz them to uncover the true sweethearts. Warm, playful and gently mischievous, the ITV series mixes bluffing, romance and Grayson's trademark charm.

name: How to Train Your Killer
summary: On the wedding night of Crown Princess Gu Qingyao, a cold-blooded assassin known as Shiyi suddenly attempts to assassinate the Crown Prince. By accident, their souls are swapped. To protect her husband, Gu Qingyao engages in a battle of wits and courage with Shiyi, as a deadly game of assassination officially begins, uncovering a thrilling power struggle between the martial world and the imperial court behind the scenes...

name: Zabić Miss
summary: This three-part docuseries chronicles the tragic story of Polish model Agnieszka Kotlarska, whose life was cut short by an obsessive fan.

name: Turbulent Love
summary: Hao Yu, the police superintendent's adopted daughter, goes deep undercover as an informant within the underworld and becomes the girlfriend of mob prince, Ji Jiejie. The ruthless and decisive Ji Jiejie, fully aware she is an informant, yet willingly succumbs and even gambles his life to protect her. When her former lover, police superintendent Zhou Ziheng, returns, where will they go as they navigate their path between justice, truth, and passion?

name: Shrimp Encounter
summary: All because of a "magic crock"! Three bumbling companions embark on a journey to repair a broken jar in an attempt to cover up their blunder. Along the way, they stumble into a spy conspiracy, accidentally discover a hidden paradise, and launch an ancient startup using their trusty drain-clearing gadget. When conspiracy collides with cuisine, and romance meets ridiculousness, this lovable trio cooks up a crayfish craze that writes a hilariously unconventional legend!

name: Falling Under the Stars
summary: To save her seriously ill mother, Lin Qingzhu strikes a deal with Chu Nanhe. Little does she know that he is actually Chu Guanxing, who has been reborn. In his previous life, his obsessiveness drove Lin Qingzhu to commit suicide. Now, filled with remorse, he returns with a new identity, helping her clear away obstacles while restraining his surging love. Lin Qingzhu feels the warmth amidst his protection. When family conspiracies and the truth are unveiled, what kind of ending will the three of them ultimately face?

name: Watch Your Back
summary: In Watch Your Back, host Soy Kroon welcomes 12 familiar faces to his country house. In the real world, they have made a name for themselves. Here, they are nothing more than a number. That number is on their back — visible to everyone except themselves. Those who know remain in the game. What do you do when everyone knows except you?

name: The Winner Takes It All
summary: The ultimate musical game show where tactics and talent come together. Fifty singers try to sing better and impress more than the rest, until only one remains.

name: Postcode Loterij In de Ring
summary: One duo in the middle, 12 rings with 100 opponents slowly closing in, and a jackpot of €50,000. A thrilling battle of wits.

name: Oh Oh Den Haag
summary: Residents of The Hague show what connects their city. Genuine locals with big hearts and sharp tongues, and respectable citizens with a sense of style and tradition. Two worlds, but one city.

name: Carrie op Vrijdag
summary: Kick off the weekend with Carrie ten Napel. Carrie welcomes a variety of guests to her clubhouse. In her upbeat Friday show, she chats with them about topics that touch, inspire, and connect us all.

name: Arts in Motion
summary: Arts in Motion is a thrilling series, showcasing renowned cultural figures sharing their insights with the next generation. This series will encompass multiple disciplines, including dance, music, visual art and performance-based work. Each episode centres around a masterclass led by a major cultural figure working with aspiring artists at the beginning of their careers. This unique opportunity allows young creatives to learn from a world leading artist and refine their craft.

name: Волшебные холмы
summary: The Magic Hills are a fairyland. It so happened that one day it was divided into four parts. Winter has remained forever on one Hill, spring on another, summer on the third, and autumn on the fourth. Funny little animals live on every Hill. But they don't know anything about each other.

name: Blind Sherlock
summary: Blessed with exceptional hearing, blind Roman Mertens lands his dream job in the local police wiretapping unit -- a job more dangerous than he expected.

name: Pro Deo
summary: Alex and her team also have to fight to stay afloat because the office is consistently underfunded. Moreover, the cases that arise are deeply affecting Alex and her colleagues. Pro Deo chronicles the lives of Alex and her team, the challenges they face in their personal lives, and how, as an "office family," they not only support each other but also sometimes get in each other's way.

name: Rust en Vreugd
summary: After her husband Thomas's death, Emma discovers that he had registered himself for the allotment garden complex Rust en Vreugd. To cope with her grief, she decided to get a garden after all. It soon became clear that the complex was anything but peaceful and joyful. Before she knew it, Emma was welcomed into the diverse community of gardeners and drawn into a full-blown power struggle over hedge heights, garden bingo, and snail control.

name: Alpha 00
summary: Alpha 00 follows a special team of police specialists who, during the most intense operations, lead a mobile command center at a violent crime scene.

name: Grand Hotel aan Zee
summary: In and around the Noordwijk seaside hotel, the lives of staff, hotel guests, and villagers intertwine – resulting in intrigue, blossoming romance, and unexpected twists. Grand Hotel aan Zee combines beautiful costumes, impressive sets, and delightful characters with timeless themes like love, motherhood, and ambition in the first ever Dutch produced costume drama.

name: Pandora
summary: Under the guidance of Ruben Nicolai, twelve participants embark on an adventure full of temptation, strategy, and dilemmas at a mythical location on the Mediterranean Sea. They place their fate in the hands of Pandora's Box. Will the participants manage to curb their curiosity and keep the famous box closed? Or will the temptation prove too strong, with all the consequences that entails?

name: Выходи за меня замуж!
summary: Nina is released after three years in prison. An unknown man is waiting for her at the gates of the colony and offers to enter into a fictitious marriage.

name: Handyman Hal
summary: Join Handyman Hal for a ride on a garbage truck, behind the scenes of a fire station and on a host of fun learning adventures about how things work.

previousepisode.name: Handyman Hal and Benji Explore the Hardware Store

name: Los Querendones
summary: Dr. Gloria Miralles is a beautiful and successful doctor who seems to have it all. But she has always resented her best friend, Fe Quintero Ruiz, a sweet, sociable literature teacher and an obedient daughter. Two events deepen Gloria's jealousy even more: Fe falls in love with the handsome Sergio Grimán, to whom Gloria is also attracted; and Gloria's mother Alicia drops the bombshell that Fe is actually Gloria's half-sister from past infidelity and is entitled to half her fortune.

name: Пороки и их поклонники
summary: Bachelor Vladimir Arkhipov lived peacefully with his faithful mastiff and had no intention of changing anything in his life. Everything happened against his will. His eccentric neighbor, Lizaveta, died, leaving him an apartment and her adopted "orphan girl" as an inheritance. The orphan turned out to be a grown woman named Masha, who stunned the lonely Arkhipov. But why didn't the neighbor leave the apartment to her? Was it because the "Path to Joy" cult was laying claim to it? Then Masha's half-brother from the provinces fell into her care, and then they both disappeared. Concerned about their disappearance and his neighbor's strange death, Arkhipov begins an investigation...

name: Братья Карамазовы
summary: Three brothers, one spiritual and living at a monastery, the other - a gambler, and the third - an intellectual, work out their problems in 19th century Russia.

name: Le tre rose di Eva
summary: Aurora is a modern-day heroine who fights for her freedom and her independence against all those who have plotted against her and imprisoned her. In the background lies a ruthless fight for the homeland, an old feud between rival families, conspiracies, secrets and unspeakable sins, brothers competing for the love of one woman.

name: Пелагия и белый бульдог
summary: In a remote Russian province in the late nineteenth century, Bishop Mitrofanii must deal with a family crisis. After learning that one of his great aunt's beloved and rare white bulldogs has been poisoned, the Orthodox bishop knows there is only one detective clever enough to investigate the murder: Sister Pelagia. Like a Russian Miss Marple, Sister Pelagia uses her extraordinary intuition to investigate terrible crimes. Based on the best-selling book by Boris Akunin.

name: Кордон следователя Савельева
summary: Savelyev decides to retire. The boss artificially drags out the process of signing the report, because Savelyev is not only his friend and cool detective, but also a real professional.

name: Odds
summary: Tom lives in a world of statistics and figures, while Neil is a true bon vivant and womanizer. These two completely different men turn out to be the perfect team for solving unsolvable crimes. Their qualities are quickly noticed by the ambitious detective Kim, who decides to hire them as consultants.

name: Scarecrow
summary: Criminal profiler Kang Tae Joo is pulled out of retirement by a chilling summons: an imprisoned serial killer has been linked to additional unsolved deaths through DNA evidence, but he insists that Tae Joo joins the investigation, believing that Tae Joo can prove his innocence. Tae Joo is brought back into a world he thought he'd left behind 33 years earlier, forcing him to face ambitious prosecutor Cha Si Young, with whom he shares a difficult past, in pursuit of the truth. But as with many cold cases, the truth isn't as straightforward as it seems – and Tae Joo might be more involved than even he knows. Can Tae Joo finally close the chapter on the "Scarecrow" murders for good, or will a new twist upend his life?

name: Yoroi-Shinden Samurai Troopers
summary: The Demon World once plunged the Human World into terror. With the seal broken and hordes of Demon Soldiers launching an invasion, five young warriors rushed to humanity's rescue. They were called the Samurai Troopers, and now their battle begins anew!

name: Oedo Fire Slayer -The Legend of Phoenix-
summary: Gengo Matsunaga, once known as Phoenix, was the greatest samurai fire-slayer in all of Edo. After leaving fire-slaying, Gengo is approached with an offer from the Shinjo Domain. Encouraged by his wife, Miyuki, he sets out to rebuild a fallen firefighting brigade. Gengo gathers a group of misfits, the Ragged Fire-Slayers, as they investigate mysterious fires started by the arsonist Kitsunebi.

name: The National Lottery: We've Got Your Number
summary: Brian Conley hosts The National Lottery: We've Got Your Number in which members of the public participate in events that revolve round the lottery draw, which takes place during the show.

name: Gold Wars Downunder
summary:
Gold Wars Downunder follows three hardcore mining teams as they battle it out on the one patch of gold-rich-land to see who can unearth the biggest nuggets and the most gold in an epic made-for-television gold hunting season. 

The sale of gold is an important source of income for hundreds of thousands of Australians, including the men and women willing to risk it all, as they venture into some of the most dangerous and inhospitable territory on the planet - hoping to strike it rich.

The miners are our narrators and through them, and their specialist mining skills, we're drawn into the wider world of remote-area alluvial gold mining. The town of Clermont has estimated gold reserves of $A750 million and the gold price is trading at 10-year historical highs. There's a modern-day gold rush going on in the town of Clermont.

name: Millionaire Hot Seat
summary:
Millionaire Hot Seat is a fast-paced, tactical twist on the classic format. Hosted by Jeremy Clarkson, the show places six contestants in a rotating "hot seat", demanding quick thinking, strategy and composure under pressure.

Six contestants compete in a queue around the Hot Seat. Only the contestant currently in the Hot Seat can answer questions on the money ladder.

Answer correctly → climb the ladder
Answer incorrectly → you're out, and the top prize drops. 
Pass → you stay in the game, but return to the back of the queue.
Passed questions must be answered by the next player correctly to stay, answer incorrectly and they're out.
Only the top remaining prize can be won.

name: Rick Stein's Australia
summary: Rick revisits his Aussie home from home. Catching up with old friends and foodie favourites, he explores exciting new dishes, from the arid Outback to the dazzling Sapphire Coast.

name: Ростов-Папа
summary: A stylish arrangement in a modern way of a number of classic love stories - "Carmen", "Orpheus and Eurydice", "Don Quixote", "Cyrano de Bergerac", "Hamlet". Each episode is a complete story with its own characters, they are united only by the place of action - the city of Rostov-on-Don. It is always summer here, women are beautiful and men are courageous, there is a high sky and a blue river, everyone is happy here or could be happy.

name: Toussaint Louverture
summary: The historical drama "Toussaint Louverture" is dedicated to the fate of Toussaint Louverture, the leader of the Haitian Revolution, as a result of which Haiti became the first independent state in Latin America.

name: Назначена награда
summary: Pasha Gaitan and Oleg Lyalakin, ordinary employees of the teaching staff, dream of becoming real "bounty hunters" and independently fight criminals, especially for a decent remuneration. The day comes when fate itself forces them to take up this trade: would-be friends are thrown out of the police with a bang.

name: Ten Deadliest Snakes with Nigel Marven
summary: Adventurous naturalist and all round snake lover Nigel Marven takes a look at some of the world's most lethal snakes.

name: The 1970s Diet: Could It Work for You?
summary:
This entertaining two-part social experiment sees presenter Josie Gibson immerse herself in the food, drink and health culture of the 1970s, to discover if the average diet from what is often seen as one of the "unhealthiest" decades in British history, could have something to teach modern eaters.

For two weeks, Josie follows a bespoke 1970s diet, carefully designed by a nutritional expert, to reflect what the average person would have eaten in that decade. She'll take a series of physiological tests before and after to see if the 70s diet and lifestyle can make her slimmer, fitter and healthier.

name: Fatal Fall: Murder or Accident
summary:
Fatal Fall: Murder or Accident is a shocking series built on a chilling premise: each episode examines a case where a victim was seemingly pushed to their death — from balconies and rooftops to cliffs, staircases, and bridges. Beyond the act itself, the series explores the interpersonal tensions and psychological buildup that led to these sudden and violent outcomes, often at the hands of someone they knew and loved, and the investigations that followed.

Through expert analysis and testimony from those closest to the victims, the series reveals how ordinary moments can turn deadly in an instant, and asks the ultimate questions: who can you truly trust, what really happened, and why.

name: Spelet
summary: Twelve famous Swedes are isolated in a luxury suite at the top of a skyscraper. Monitored 24/7, they navigate a brutal power game where cunning, pacts and betrayal are necessary to avoid being voted out. The rules of the game are simple – but unfair. Both power and money influence the participants in the mini-society created in the suite. One by one, they are ruthlessly voted out by the group until only one winner remains.

nextepisode.name: Att vara eller inte vara immun, det är frågan

name: Robinson - Exit
summary: We follow the Robinson participants as they leave the great adventure, from the moment they board the boat to the first bite of real food.

name: Lueat Kakee
summary: Talap, a beautiful slave girl was raped by her master Manas. As a result, his first wife Thanthip hates her. Pregnant from the assault, Talap's child ends up dying after delivery as the result of Thanthip's vengeance. In retaliation, Talap decides to take away Thanthip's own daughter. As time passes, the abducted young girl grows into a beautiful young woman. Now Talap plans on bringing the father and daughter into a forbidden relationship for the ulitmate revenge.

name: Hua Jai Patapee
summary: The story is about Forest Conservation. The main lead are special agents from the National Forest Ranger Department.

name: Roi Arkart
summary: The murder mystery of the business tycoon Paisarn leads his children to come face to face again. Including Ansaya who is about to become the newest member of the family. But… the first case hasn't been solved, a new case arises that made her and Paam, Jao Sua's younger brother and also her first love become suspects. Their love then rekindles in the midst of danger and the real murderer that no one suspected.

name: LMN's: Adventures in the Microworld
summary: After a failed experiment, Dr. No, an evil scientist obsessed with world domination, and Chip, a cute and clever 9-year-old boy, are sent by the beam of a particle accelerator to the atomic world of Microworld.

name: STUCK: The Chronicles of David Rea
summary: David Rea works as Emotional Trainer dealing with all kinds of people in existential block.

name: Unseen Islands
summary: Islands born of fire run from the equatorial Atlantic down to Antarctica. Many are now home to unique species and all have intriguing stories to tell.

name: O Sorriso do Lagarto
summary: Life and love of ladies man Joao, while lab outside of town does experiments on lizards and people.

name: Ozie Boo!
summary: Ozie Boo! tells the story of five baby penguins, four boys and a girl, who learn to cohabit in a joyous and friendly way and have many adventures in their home, located in the middle of the Atlantic Ocean.

name: Oretachi Bad Barbers
summary: On the surface, they're barbers, but behind the scenes, they're... Ryoshi! A retro-style barbershop tucked away in a rural town. The two men who work there have hidden lives. "For 3 million yen, we'll straighten up your life." The Ryoshi take on any problem that can't be solved in the real world, straightening out their clients' messy lives and cutting their hair. This mysterious barbershop, run by two clumsy men, will once again see someone off to a fresh start.

name: Gu Xiong
summary: The show centers on a lone wolf, a tough guy among tough guys, grappling with his identity and purpose. As the curtains draw on his solitary existence, a question lingers: Where does a lost soul, a true lone wolf, seek his rightful place in the world?

name: K-foodie meets J-foodie
summary: Korea's top foodie Sung Si-kyung joins Japan's beloved Yutaka Matsushige on a tasty adventure as they explore culinary gems across Korea and Japan.

previousepisode.name: An Irresistible Taste That Keeps You Coming Back

name: Kántor
summary: The unique career of Kántor, the most successful tracker dog in the history of Hungarian law enforcement.

name: La Otra Cara del Alma
summary: After her parents die, a vengeful Alma fights to reclaim her stolen inheritance but her self-destructive desires prevent true happiness until she must choose between love or revenge.

name: Solamente vos
summary: The story of a group of friends: those who love themselves, those who hate themselves, and those who are a real family.

name: L'ombra del destino
summary: An unsettling and inexplicable series of crimes, apparently connected to the old nonsense rhyme, upsets the peaceful lives of the inhabitants of San Giorgio, a splendid island in the middle of the Mediterranean. An investigation is undertaken by the hard-hitting and rational Inspector Pietro Montero and his female partner Deputy Inspector Lara De Falco, of more sensitive and instinctive disposition. Their mission is to put an end to a gruesome chain of murders, by finding a middle ground in the infinite expanse between the rational and the mystical...

name: Dora, la celadora
summary: Dora Lara is a woman of strong character who works as a caretaker of an important building in the city, there she will live incredible stories that could lead her to know her true love.

name: El Ángel Caído
summary: María de los Ángeles is known by all her neighbors as a good, honest and very educated woman; however, she is actually a bitter person and capable of anything in order to get enough money to support herself financially

name: Sei donne - Il mistero di Leila
summary: The disappearance of a little girl, Leila, and her stepfather Gregorio, is the mystery around which the story of the series develops. A psychological thriller in which the search for truth intersects with the stories of six women of today - Anna, Michela, Alessia, Viola, Aysha, Leila - each with her own experience, each with her own secrets, representative of a contemporary female universe , between determination and fragility, love and hate, constraints and freedom

name: Nikolaj og Julie
summary: Copenhagen thirtysomethings Nikolaj and Julie struggle with marriage, baby and work, plus friends of varying maturity.

name: Spain with Michael Portillo
summary: Michael Portillo takes us on a journey deep into his Secret Spain.

name: Вдовий пароход
summary: Anfisa's happy married life ends with the news of the outbreak of war. Four other women live with her in a communal apartment, each of whom was crippled by fate.

name: Ainsley's Taste of The Bahamas
summary: Ainsley Harriott travels to The Bahamas to meet the people behind its vibrant island cuisine, from local producers to beachside chefs.

name: The Salvage Squad
summary:
Creating Show-stopping Homes...That don't cost the Earth!

Can we achieve the home renovation of our dreams without it literally costing the earth?

A makeover show with a new sustainable twist, Our host and the teams will be challenged to transform our bland old rooms, furniture and fittings into unique and stunning show stoppers, using only up-cycling and sustainable methods.

This is the home makeover format for the world we live in today, as 2 households per week, each with a team consisting of an interior designer and an up-cycling wiz, have just 3 days and €1,000 to renovate and rejuvenate a tired space in their home, filling them with home-made, re-used and revamped furnishings.

In our buy new culture, many of us shun second hand décor…. and as a result …..mountains of furniture ends up in landfill every year. 

But what if we could show you how to make over your home using only second-hand goods? 

Only one question remains…. Will our homeowners love it? Or Skip it?

name: Valley of the Kings: Secret Tomb Revealed
summary: With over 60 tombs, the Valley of the Kings is the most-famous burial ground on Earth. In the biggest Egyptian excavation ever, a team of archaeologists led by Zahi Hawass heads into the Western Valley to hunt for evidence of an undiscovered tomb.

name: Kings and Queens of England
summary: Kings and Queens of England is a six-part docuseries from UKTV History. Presented by historian Alan Ereira, this docuseries chronicles nearly 1,000 years of England's monarchy. From the Norman Conquest in 1066 to the Windsors, each episode delves into a specific period, highlighting how monarchs influenced the nation's history and how their personal lives and decisions shaped the Great Britain we know today.

name: Ruben langs de Zuid-Chinese Zee
summary: Ruben Terlou returns to China and the countries surrounding the South China Sea, scene of rapidly escalating tensions. As China tightens its grip on the sea and islands, neighboring countries like Japan, the Philippines and Vietnam feel threatened. In eight episodes, Ruben investigates what this power struggle means for the people who live there.

name: Great Military Blunders
summary:
We have long saluted military genius and bravery. But the other side of the coin is military incompetence – a largely preventable, tragically expensive, yet totally absorbing aspect of human behaviour.

From the Crusades to Vietnam, history is littered with examples of stupidity, obduracy, brutality and sheer breath-taking incompetence. Lack of communication, technological failure and a misplaced sense of superiority have led to the deaths of thousands of ordinary soldiers, let down by their masters and betrayed by arrogance. Using a combination of history, human interest and archive footage underpinned by powerful story-telling, Great Military Blunders charts man's folly and cruelty in a series of stunning debacles, spanning almost a thousand years of conflict.

name: 6th Sense Agency
summary: A cash-strapped young man, a gifted realtor and a pair of fake exorcists form an unlikely squad to sell houses haunted by spirits.

name: Ryojin no Ono
summary: The eldest daughter of Detective Shibasaki Sachio from the First Investigation Division is found stabbed to death. He goes after the truth with Kawasumi Shigekatsu, a junior detective who respects Shibasaki as his mentor in life and is a close family friend. However, the hard work of the police is in vain. There are no developments due to the numerous questionable points at the crime scene and case goes unsolved. 15 years later, Shibasaki is retired and quietly spending the rest of his life looking after his wife Miwako who is seriously ill. However, the situation suddenly changes with the establishment of a unit specialising in re-investigating unsolved cases. Kawasumi also joins them. As the case is being reexamined, the existence of man who is believed to be the criminal emerges.

name: Looking After Jo Jo
summary: A four-part drama of love and betrayal set among the housing estates of eighties Edinburgh.

name: Time Traveler's Disease
summary: Mirai, a 25-year-old man who keeps to himself, is hiding a certain secret from his beloved wife, Meguru... The truth is that he's suffering from an unexplained disease that causes him to travel back in time whenever he experiences sudden, intense emotions. It was Meguru who brought him solace from his suffering. But then, on the day of their wedding anniversary, Meguru falls to her death down the emergency stairs at her workplace. Why did a cheerful and simple-hearted person like her have to die? What if she was actually murdered by someone? Mirai falls into deep despair and travels back in time. Can he save Meguru using his ability to suddenly time-travel, despite not having control over it?

name: Fire of Desire
summary: Kenneth decided to go to Thailand with his best friend Yuth. Yuth was asked to come home urgently because his family was bankrupt. Ken wanted to help by lending the money from his inheritance but he must be married before he could get any money. To Ken that's not a problem because he fell in love with Yuth's sister PeangUma and is willing to marry her. Unfortunately, PeangUma did not even give him a chance to love but married Ken anyway to help her family. PeangUma hated all caucasians because her dearest aunt died from a broken heart caused by her aunt's caucasian husband. While Ken was trying to show how much he loved her, she kept pushing him away until it's almost too late.

name: I Wanna Be Sup'tar
summary: A story that explores the relationship between two women from opposing parts of the realm of stardom. One has never tasted success, and another who, having experienced incredible success, was left disillusioned by the entertainment industry's cruelty and now wishes to run far away from it all. Unintentionally, the two end up living together when one has just moved into this house and the other refuses to move out.

name: #Cold Game
summary: Earth plunges into a -45°C ice age, where survival eclipses money and status, and resources are scarce. Kimura Shoko, a genius con artist with a criminal past, joins a shelter valuing family above all. Posing as the "mother" of a fake family, she struggles to endure the harsh conditions while fueled by her longing to reunite with her son.

previousepisode.name: I'll live because anything is fine

name: Flame of Chimplee
summary: Natrai, the owner of a big logging business, disguises himself as a manager when he goes to the forest to check up on his employees. There, under the disguise of being a mere manager named Nantrai, he falls in love at first sight with Nuea Nang, the very beautiful granddaughter of the village elder who is called in to perform a folk dance at his welcoming party in the last minute after the main dancer injures herself. Fallen completely in love, Nantrai or Natrai does everything he can in order to win the beautiful girl's heart. In the meantime, his tyrant mother is all set to marry him to Kairkai, a hi-so crazy, greedy woman adamant on marrying Natrai.

name: Jamloei Rak
summary: Harit Rangsiman, a pearl farm owner in the south of Thailand is very angry and vengeful after Harin, his only younger brother, commits suicide because of a woman name Sansanee breaks up with him. Harit wants to take vengeance on the girl who caused his brother's death. He kidnaps who he thinks is Sansanee to torture her, but he doesn't know that the girl that he kidnaps is Soraya, Sansanee's cousin. Soraya lives in the same house with Sansanee and her parents because her own parents died a long time ago. Harit believes that Soraya is Sansanee no matter how many times Soraya tries to tell him she isn't. Soraya ends up accepting all the punishment doled out by Harit due to her wanting to repay her debt of gratitude to Sansanee because Sansanee once saved her life from drowning when they were young.

name: Anguished Love
summary: Pikul and Luang Yot's love began when he saved her from drowning in Suphan. As a talented flutist in her father's orchestra, Pikul's family moved in with Luang Yot's family, supported by his father. Class differences led them to elope, but their love is cursed by a "rattlesnake" flute Pikul inherited. Sarapee, in love with Luang Yot, kills Pikul's family and his mother. In the end, Pikul dies thinking Luang Yot betrayed her, while he is killed by Sarapee. In their second life, Pikul's vengeful spirit seeks to make those responsible pay for their karma.

name: Blue Murder Motel
summary: When an Aussie cop couple trade their badges for a quiet life managing a beachside motel in New Zealand, they plan to leave police work behind them - that is until crime comes to them.

name: Sweet Trap
summary: Bussababan's family was ruined, and now she's homeless. She blames the owner of one of the most famous vineyards in the country. She decides to take revenge by marrying her abuser in order to ruin him later, and goes to study winemaking in Okanagan, Canada. But Bussababan still doesn't know that she chose the wrong object of revenge, and falls in love with the master of the vineyard, taking him for a simple manager.

name: Ultimate Tag
summary: Ultimate Tag is an Australian sports entertainment competition adapted from the American show of the same name. The show centers on an extreme, high-energy version of the classic playground game, with contestants racing through a series of indoor obstacle courses while elite professional taggers pursue them.

name: Непутевая невестка
summary: During the divorce, the parents of six‑year‑old Denis sent him to the Rozhkovs — his grandparents. Denis's father dies by accident, and a year later, Lisa, Denis's mother, comes to the Rozhkovs and demands that the child be returned. The grandson is the last joy in the Rozhkovs' lives; they throw out their hated daughter‑in‑law. However, Lisa is determined to fight for the child. The Rozhkovs understand that sooner or later they will lose the battle for their grandson: the court will take the mother's side. The only way not to lose Denis is to marry Lisa off to a local man who will never leave the village. But how to do it?..

name: Трюкачи
summary: Professionals in film stunts are invited to the filming by Tigran Keosayan, Yegor Konchalovsky, and Vsevolod Shilovsky. Of course, the famous directors will play themselves in the series. The film's action begins with a piece of news that shakes the stunt world. The film company Columbia Pictures is going to shoot a film about British intelligence services here. The budget is beyond all bounds. In connection with this, a competition is to be held among Russian stuntmen. The real contenders for victory are two stunt teams: "our" heroes (Fighter, Physicist, Racer, Zyuzya), as well as a group of "bad guys," without honor or conscience, under the control of a certain Knight (Igor Zhukovsky). As the story unfolds, the "villains" will try in every possible way to make life difficult for "our" heroes and take them out of the competition for the contract. For example, they will set them up with an oligarch (actor Sergei Astakhov), who will promise the stuntmen large fees for participating in a banquet he is organizing. And after the performance at the same banquet, a corpse will be discovered. The viewers of REN TV will find out and punish the scoundrel. The series contains a lot of unique information about the inner workings of stunt cinema. Viewers will learn purely professional secrets about performing a number of extremely complex stunts.

name: Carlos V: Los caminos del Emperador
蜜恋失心
summary: This is a story about the trivial story of the overbearing president Xiao Xiao in the relationship with the nephew Mei Ruobin, but in the increasingly unstable mental state and increasingly complex interpersonal relationships, he found himself living in a world of lies. Xiao Wei is the vice president of Yuanhang Media. In order to pursue her goddess Mei Xin, she will not hesitate to take care of her younger brother Mei Ruobin who returned to study when she was on a business trip.

name: Eventyrerne: Jakten på spektralsteinene
summary: Three driven entertainers throw themselves into an adventure created by game master Aslak Maurstad. How far will imagination, cleverness and dice take them? Radio podcast with video.

name: Странствия и невероятные приключения одной любви
summary: The sleepy life in a resort seaside town during the off‑season. Trumpeter Sasha is a musician by nature, going through a "midlife crisis". He lives alone, unburdened by either a family or bad habits; in the evenings he plays in the local orchestra, and sometimes, in his endless quest for freedom and new experiences, he disappears to who knows where for a week or two. Vera is a pretty woman who isn't yet old; she lives in the hope of meeting her "one and only". Two lonely people, longing for unattainable happiness, met and started living together. And so everything was fine, but one day, after stepping out for five minutes to buy bread, Sasha disappeared. For many years, Vera will search for her beloved. No changes — neither marriage, nor moving to Moscow, nor a successful career — will make her forget about the strange man who stirred her soul. In the lovers' lives, there will be wonderful meetings, heartfelt conversations, fateful trials, and mysterious partings. Their fate is passion on the brink of death.

name: Взять живым
summary: About the fate of soldier Vasily Romashkin, a tenth-grader who survived all the trials of the Great Patriotic War and ended his military career as an intelligence officer.

name: A Touch Away
summary: Impossible love story between Zorik - new immigrant from Russia and Roha'Le - a daughter of Hassidic family.

name: Guardians of Nature
summary: This series of documentaries is dedicated to discovering the magnificent scenery of mainland France and its territories throughout the world. These regions are remarkable for their natural wealth and beauty, and for the man made structures that have been established to protect them. Reserves, national parks, mangroves, islands, marshlands and coral reefs are all examples of how man and nature have carved out and shaped these jewels of nature. In the company of scientists, nature lovers and « guardians » of these sites, all of whom are involved in the study and the protection of an enchanting yet fragile flora and fauna, this series will take you to rare and precious French land and seascapes where man can still find himself in total harmony with nature.

name: Myth of Sword
summary: A cat and mouse chase between Shen Shi Wu, the number one constable in the area and Liu Xing Yu who is a a troublemaking delinquent. Repeated encounters pave the way for a growing camaraderie as the two enter into several crime solving antics throughout the course of the story.

name: Тайна Эдвина Друда
summary: Edwin Drood is engaged to marry Rosa when he comes of age, but when the day comes, they agree to break off the engagement. Shortly afterwards, Edwin vanishes leaving his uncle Jasper and a mysterious detective named Dick to investigate.

name: Bekännelsen
summary: Nina and Thomas, a young couple in their thirties, are expecting a baby. They live in a small community and are in the process of renovating their house which is situated on a lake outside the village. Thomas works at a gas station and gets help with the renovation from Nina's brother, Sigge, who works at the town bakery. One day an Estonian couple come to the gas station. Their meeting with Thomas and Sigge starts off well but ends badly, changing and ruining lives in the process.

name: Florentina
summary: Flo is a spontaneous, charming chatterbox who can hold her own in the tough health and fitness business of her mother. Just before her wedding, she is dumped and inherits a secret nightclub from her mysterious uncle.

name: Tiere bis unters Dach
summary: The Hansen family runs a veterinary practice in the Black Forest. For Greta, her sister Lilie, father Philipp and mother Annette, everything revolves around the four-legged friends who live with them.

name: Ты не один
summary: Stories about the everyday life of lawyers whose specialization is operational work on call. Three employees - a lawyer Vladimir Kuzmin, a former police officer Maksim Zagorskiy and a graduate of a prestigious law school Natalya Shatova, using their abilities, opportunities, useful connections and contacts, urgently come to the rescue on the first call.

name: מילואים
summary: "Milluim" describes the experiences of reserve soldiers called up for service, and takes the viewers through the training, strategy, team work, and different missions.

name: Off The Grid Living
summary: It's time to take house-hunting to the extreme as we search for the best properties way off the beaten track. Find out what happens when prospective buyers seek out isolated locations for the perfect quirky home. This brand-new series includes Matt and Kelly, who want to swap their humdrum existence for a new pad in the jungle of Costa Rica, complete with solar energy and a 3G connection; Stefani and Jason, who plan to move to Haida Gwai in British Columbia, where the total population numbers 4,000 hardy souls; and Ollie, who is relocating from Australia to Svalbard in Norway, just 700 miles from the North Pole.

name: 30 prípadu majora Zemana
summary: A series of stories based of books of known Czech writers Robert Shuliga and Jiri Prochazka about the exciting adventures of the National Security Corps officer struggling against the remnants of the Nazi agents.

name: Третье измерение
summary: An action‑packed film story about the crew of a nuclear submarine of the Red Banner Northern Fleet.

name: Вторая мировая. Великая Отечественная
summary:
Many people believe that after so many years, there are simply no more gaps in the history of the greatest and most tragic war. But is that really the case? The more historians study the events of World War II, the clearer it becomes: we know very little not only about yesterday's enemies, but also about former allies.

Who planned to deliver a crushing blow to the Soviet Union's rear, defeating Red Army units in Europe immediately after Germany signed the surrender? Did British intelligence really save the Reich's "grey cardinal," Martin Bormann, from death in Berlin? How did a weapon of mass destruction become a weapon of mass deception? Why did the Germans so easily break through the "impregnable" fortifications on the western border of the USSR in the summer of 1941? What was the purpose of the NKVD's re‑investigation into the circumstances surrounding Hitler's disappearance? What is true in this story, and what is just a myth?

In search of answers to these and other questions, the creators of the documentary series "World War II. "The Great Patriotic War" visited countries that fought for the future of Europe and the world in the 1940s. Several film crews worked in parallel on three continents. In addition to Russia, the project's authors travelled to Germany, France, Italy, Georgia, the Czech Republic, the United Kingdom, the USA, Canada, and Argentina. During their trips, they managed to obtain a number of unique testimonies and documents.

name: Scroll Patrol
summary: Scroll Patrol is an inside look into the life of RuPaul's Drag Race Season 2 and All Stars 10 icon, Nicole Paige Brooks. Nicole is scrolling through her camera roll, sharing never-before-seen photos and stories from her 30-year drag career, her personal life, and her RuPaul's Drag Race journey.

name: Под небом Вероны
summary: 1984. Andrei Mazurov, a reliable worker in the Committee of Youth Organizations who had served in Afghanistan and believed in the party's ideals, is sent to a seminar in Italy. In Verona, he meets his true and only love. His Juliet turns out to be a Jewish girl, Leah, who has come with her father to a congress of rabbis. Fate gives them a few fleeting encounters in the most romantic city in the world, and then each must return home — Leah to Israel, Andrei to the USSR. In those days, their states were at odds; there weren't even diplomatic relations between them. The lovers make desperate attempts to find each other, but their parents, the "iron curtain," and political and cultural prejudices seem to keep them apart forever. But it's no coincidence that their love was born under the skies of Verona — after going through the most difficult trials, they meet again years later...

name: The Wildlife Man featuring David Ireland
summary: Encounters with dangerous creatures are part of David Ireland's day job - he is the Wildlife Man. David Ireland is one of the world's most experienced wildlife television presenters. An expert diver, cameraman and bushman, he has also spent years in the Australian outback learning the Aboriginal way of life. In this series he encounters some of the world's wildest and most fascinating creatures.From tropical jungles to rugged mountains, deep sea shipwrecks to harsh deserts, the Wildlife Man captures never-before-seen animal behaviour and takes you on a thrilling ride into the wilderness.

name: Верю я в любовь
summary: On the eve of her daughter's wedding, seamstress Nadezhda Matveeva catches her husband Gennadiy with his young lover Marina.

name: Что я наделала?!
summary: How can plastic surgery disfigure? At what point does the desire to look better turn into a dangerous experiment? Are you willing to pay with your health for a "perfect" appearance? "What have I done?!" is a documentary project in which victims of plastic surgery will honestly tell where the enhancement has led them. And experienced doctors will try to fix what unscrupulous specialists have done.

name: I Kill U
summary: The story unfolds as a part-timer who was once a promising Taekwondo player, but now has a resemblance to the biological granddaughter of Beomhan Construction, who was accused of being the main culprit in a hit-and-run while drunk, and takes on the role of appearing in the media on her behalf.

name: 19 Keys
summary: 19 Keys is a British game show that aired on Five in late 2003. Across 20 episodes broadcast on weeknights from 10 November to 5 December, contestants competed in a quiz format where correct answers unlocked numbered keys leading to prizes. The show combined general knowledge questions with a strategic element of choosing which key might open the next reward.

name: Ayrılık Sevdaya Dahil
summary: Kemal, the collector and overall stronghold of a loan shark family,  confronts scriptwriter and obligatory restaurant owner Afife for a debt. This confrontation plunges them into emotions they never anticipated; they soon realize that love and honor are nothing like what they once believed.

name: The Red Cradle
summary: In the autumn and winter of 1946, amid shifting tides of war, the Yan'an Second Nursery is ordered to evacuate 136 children to safety. Thus begins a perilous journey known as "The Long March of the Little Ones." Through gunfire, harsh terrain, and relentless danger, the caretakers and soldiers shield the children with their lives until the final child reaches safety in an epic tale of sacrifice and survival.

previousepisode.name: Ep.16 / Final Round -We are No No Girls-

name: Peregrina
summary:
The story unfolds in a small town in Venezuela. Miriam contracts leukaemia and dies giving birth to a baby girl. Her husband, Dr. Mirabal, dies in an accident. The child, Gisela, is taken in by her maternal grandfather, Mr. Mendoza. His wife, who is also Miriam's stepmother, wants the Mendoza fortune to go to her twin sons from her first marriage, Juan Carlos and Rolando. For this reason, she gives the girl to some gypsy circus owners who are passing through town.

Twenty years later, the circus returns. Mr. Mendoza and his sister, Yolanda, see Gisela and notice that the little gypsy girl has the same features as the deceased Miriam, leading them to conclude that she is the lost child. Rolando, as ambitious as his mother, learns that Gisela is the heiress to the Mendoza fortune. He seduces her and marries her to seize the wealth. On their honeymoon, Gisela overhears a conversation and discovers that Rolando doesn't love her; he married her for her money. Devastated, Gisela returns home unaware that Rolando has been murdered, and she is presumed dead. Juan Carlos, Rolando's twin brother, hates Gisela and believes she killed him. He assumes Rolando's identity to exact his revenge.

name: Banjo and Ro's Grand Island Hotel
summary:
Situated 150 metres off the west coast of the Isle of Mull in Scotland, Ulva used to have a population of 800 but now just 14 call it home. At the centre of the island stands Ulva House, a once enchanting Regency home, the former residence of the first Governor of Australia, Lachlan MacQuarrie.

In recent years, Ulva House has stood abandoned and fallen into disrepair. Banjo and Ro's Grand Island Hotel will follow the trials, tribulations, design dilemmas and community spirit it takes to bring Ulva House back to life and, hopefully, turn it into a must-visit getaway.

Along the way, the couple - who have relocated to Ulva along with Grampa the dog as well as their chickens and pigs - will face the challenges of remote island life and a limited budget but these two dreamers are determined to transform the crumbling mansion into a stunning destination hotel.

name: No Way Back VIPS
summary: Fourteen famous Dutch people are trekking through the Albanian wilderness with ex-commando John Sohilait. In the untouched nature, where wild bears and wolves roam, they have to make a choice: stay behind in a survival camp or continue to the finish line. With a prize pool of 100,000 euros, there is a lot at stake.

name: Style of Hiroshi Nohara's Lunch
summary: The story focuses on Hiroshi Nohara, Shin-chan's father and the head of the Nohara family. As a 35-year-old salaryman, he has limited time and money to spend on food, which shapes his choice of lunchtime. Throughout the manga, Hiroshi describes the food, delivers food trivia, and gripes about workplace woes, such as having to treat his seniors to food, sudden workloads shortening his lunch break, and hated bosses.

previousepisode.name: The Style of Okonomiyaki / The Style of Katsudon

name: Masumiyet Müzesi
summary: Selahattin Paşalı stars as a man undone by obsession, desperately clinging to memories of a love that slips further away with every attempt to hold on.

name: I'll Live a Long Life to Dote on My Favorite Stepbrother!
summary: Alba was reincarnated as the son of a poor noble family. In his new life, he is introduced to his new step-brother Orsis, through his mother's second marriage. Orsis happens to be Alba's favorite character from an otome game he played in his previous life. Alba is ecstatic until he realizes his own character's death is the reason his step-brother loses his smile. Alba is determined to find a way to live longer.

name: Muscle Farmers
summary: Five physical strength entertainers help with farming work by harvesting various crops.

name: A.B.İ.
summary: Doğan escapes his family's dark past and embarks on a completely different life, only to be forced to confront secrets years later.

name: Los Colorado
summary: The Colorado is back, and now he has a family. Along with his wife, children, and grandmother, he must save Chaotic City while dealing with chaos at home. From cavemen to intergalactic beings, no one will escape The Colorado..

previousepisode.name: Não Há Clone Que Não Venha Para o Bem

name: A Question of Entertainment
summary: A Question of Entertainment is a light-hearted BBC quiz show where host Tom O'Connor asks two teams of celebrities amusing and varied questions on film, TV, music and other showbiz topics, with team captains Ken Dodd and Larry Grayson leading the fun. Lively banter and pop-culture trivia make for entertaining viewing.

name: Lies for Love
summary: After awakening in a hospital bed with complete amnesia, Chen Jinxue stumbles upon a terrifying secret hidden in a locked room... Playing the part of the forgetful patient, she forms an unlikely alliance. Her husband Jiang Chen's ex-wife turned private eye, his current mistress, and a fellow victim. Bound by vengeance, these four women conspire to deliver the devil himself into damnation. But as roles reverse and the hunter becomes the hunted, a high-stakes game of identity, memory, and retribution unfolds.

name: Leaders Playbook
summary: Leaders Playbook, an in-depth series offering candid conversations with visionary leaders about their strategies and philosophies.

name: Saving Country Houses with Penelope Keith
summary: From cafes to craft fairs, glamping to ghosts, Penelope meets the owners of Britain's country houses trying to keep their historic homes intact.

name: A Hundred Percent
summary: A Hundred Percent is about a group of friends working inside the Thought Leader industrial complex. Their books, podcasts and morning routines might help us live our lives more perfectly, but away from the screens and mics, they are most definitely far from perfect.

name: Something in the Wind
summary: Daracha is a 35-year-old woman who is well educated and has a simple life with a set routine. After the failure of her first love, she has never opened up her heart to anyone. That is, until one day Wayu arrives into her world. The younger man is in his late twenties but loves to live his life freely, without the restrictions of a nine to five job and other societal expectations. Despite being so different from each other, the two fall in love and are happy. However, everyone around Daracha considers this relationship to be unacceptable as Wayu does not have a stable job like her and spends his life only for today without planning for the future or taking quick actions when problems arise. Wayu slowly realises how different the two of them are, and the feelings of uncertainty begin to grow bigger when one day Daracha's first love, Songwat, arrives and begins to influence their life. Suddenly it is time Daracha makes a decision for the future

name: Più forti del destino
summary: Palermo, 1897. At the inauguration of the exhibition of new technologies, an unstoppable fire causes many victims and forever upsets the destinies of three women: Arianna, Costanza and Rosalia. A costume drama, which still represents current issues. The protagonists fight for their own salvation from a destiny that seems already sealed, stubbornly striving for their own emancipation and achievement of happiness.

name: Boyfriend on Demand
summary: Seo Mi-rae is worn out by work. Love? It's the last thing on her mind. But a virtual dating service sparks feelings - and maybe a real shot at romance.

name: La Sposa
summary: Italy, late 60s. In order to save her family from poverty, Maria, a Calabrian woman, accepts to marry Italo, nephew of a rough farmer living in Vicenza.

name: Prithvi Vallabh: Itihaas Bhi, Rahasya Bhi
summary: Prithvi Vallabh is a tale of two powerful states constantly at war. Mrinal of Manyakheta dynasty nursed an enmity against Malwa since childhood as they were responsible for her parents' death. The battle brings two warring souls; Mrinal and Prithvi face to face. The animosity leads to deception, and rejection that gradually transcends into a heart rending passionate love story- a love story that perhaps was never meant to be. Here is a unique story that starts with hatred in a battlefield and ends up becoming the biggest love story, one that has never been told before.

name: Bekenntnisse des Hochstaplers Felix Krull
summary:
Based on unfinished 1954 novel by the German author Thomas Mann. It is a parody of Goethe's autobiography Poetry and Truth, particularly in its pompous tone.

A young man gains social and amorous advantages through deception and his good looks.

name: Schlafende Riesen - Die Macht der Vulkane
summary: In the 6th century AD, large parts of the world were affected by mysterious weather events causing temperature drop, crop failures and famines. All this might be the result of a large volcanic eruption in the tropics. But can a local natural disaster impact the global weather, thus influencing the course of history? Using stunning re-enactments and unique animation techniques, "The Power of Volcanoes" makes it clear: Volcanoes might be sleeping giants. But they can wake up quicker than you think and in the worst case trigger a fatal chain of events.

previousepisode.name: In the Shade of Burning Mountains

name: Insectia
summary: A high definition look at some of the world's most interesting insects.

name: Kosmoo
summary: Robbe and his dog Kosmoo are best friends. When Kosmoo is involved in an accident, he can only be saved by giving him bionic elements. Because of these elements, Kosmoo now has phenomenal powers. A new hero is born.

name: Молодые и злые
summary: He is a former criminal. She is a special forces soldier. They have nothing in common except... mutual attraction and a desire to get to the bottom of the truth. However, will they retain the former after learning the latter? The brave fighter against the "criminal element," Veronika Grekova, having become disillusioned with her profession, is seriously considering resigning and settling down for a quiet family life with a balanced, reliable partner. The promising IT specialist, Alexander Demidov, dreams of taking on a major leadership position and marrying his fiancée. Just one call will ruin all their brilliant plans and throw them into a whirlwind of criminal events, the trail of which stretches back into the past.

name: Tous sur orbite
summary: This educational experience provides insights into the diameters, orbits, velocities, and temperatures of nine planets and their moons.

name: Aillte
summary: A stunning ode to the power and majesty of Irish sea cliffs, exploring the intimate relationships they have with the fascinating flora, fauna and the people that call them home. Marine biologist Cormac Mac Fhionnlaoich brings us on a mesmerising tour of the cliffs at Sliabh Liag.

name: 74.5 Uma Onda no Ar
summary:
In Pedra da Lua, a paradisaical city by the sea, the old journalist Álvaro keeps radio 74.5 Uma Onda on the air, radiating hope, humour and high spirits. The starting point is the arrival of Luiza, the radio host's granddaughter, who returns after suffering a severe disappointment in her marriage to Caíque. Starting a new life again, the young woman falls in love with Miguel, an ex-boyfriend who lives on a boat and lives taking tourists out.

Miguel is the son of a fisherman and has been passionate about the sea since he was a boy. As a child, he and Luiza dated. They both believe that, in past lives, he would have been a porpoise, and she was a mermaid. For socioeconomic reasons, both had to choose different lives. He got a scholarship and went to study marine biology in the United States; Luiza ended up marrying the ambitious and manipulative Caíque.

Unhappy with her marriage and life in the big city, she returns to the paradisaical Pedra da Lua, to look for her grandfather Álvaro, and ends up meeting her old love again.

name: Duda & Dada
summary: This is a story of how a little happy-go-lucky mole, 'Duda' befriends a cheerful explorer 'Dada' and has exciting adventures together.

name: Fosca Innocenti
summary: We are in Arezzo, in Tuscany, where Fosca Innocenti lives, an assistant superintendent with a casual beauty and an extraordinary gift. His sense of smell transforms every perceived fragrance into a decisive clue. Around her, we find an almost all female police squad. Provincial stories and related crimes. No mafia, no Camorra. A microworld immersed in nature that in four episodes tells about universal themes through the investigations of our protagonist.

name: Das Haus der Krokodile
summary: While his parents are on vacation, twelve-year-old Victor Laroche wants to uncover the mystery surrounding the death of a girl who fell over a banister in the same house 20 years earlier. His sisters Cora and Louise help him. Through stories told by an elderly uncle, the father of the girl named Cäcilie, they come across a former friend of Cäcilie's, Friedrich Mörlin. The series title refers to a small leather crocodile that Victor finds in the house during his investigations.

name: Caterina e le sue figlie
summary: A single mother, Caterina, is abandoned by her husband and has to raise her three daughters alone, reorganizing her life by working as a postwoman and starting a new relationship, while her daughters grow up facing their own loves and problems, in an alternation of comedy, drama, and family misunderstandings.

name: Trainer Games
summary: Trainer Games chronicles ten elite competitors as they fight their way through treacherous challenges set against stunning backdrops of Mauritius, an island in the Indian Ocean known for its adventure landscapes.

name: Mocosos Latosos
summary: After the internal and violent conflict that comes with the transition from childhood to adolescence, seven intrepid, troubled, and scheming children join their lives when they meet at a mysterious and extraordinary school in Mexico City, commanded by the rigid Director Héctor Manríquez (Rubén Cerda), who suffers from his difficult past and is obsessed with education and discipline to become better.

name: Zhua Zhu Cai Hong De Nan Ren
summary: Around the beginning of 1900's, Jiang Yu met Wu Cai Hong and was attracted by her kindness and beauty. He unwittingly discovered she was the daughter of his enemy, and her father sudden death made him the primary suspect. Their path crossed in an effort to find the truth. The closer they worked together, the deeper their mutual attraction, and the harder they hid their feelings. Will the truth give them the permission to love, or will it be their end?

name: Ultraman Jîdo
summary: After escaping from the raid of giant monster Skull Gomora, Riku Asakura and his partner Pega stumbled upon a secret base lay 500m underground. Given the Geed Riser and Ultra Capsules by operating system Rem, he transforms into Ultraman Geed and becomes a hero that his childhood inspired.

name: Kuhlab satan
summary: Rose seeks revenge on Choke, who killed her family when she was a child. Unbeknownst to him, she survived. Now, living under a new identity and gifted with visions of the future, she uses her abilities to get close to Choke's brother, Chat.

name: Padiwaradda
summary: To show gratitude to her adoptive father, Rin Rapee accepts to disguise herself as his real daughter and marry Saran, to keep the promise their fathers had made in the past. Saran is a cold-hearted guy who suffers from his previous love. Although he knows that Rin's adoptive family has deceived him, he does not wish to return his bride, since he gets to know her beauty and kindness. Love slowly grows. But soon their love is tested, when Duangsawad, his ex-lover, returns to him, while Rin also feels guilty with the secret she is hiding from him.

name: Jiajia's Lovely Journey
summary: After being unemployed and abandoned by her boyfriend, He Jia Jia left the urban life for the countryside. He Jia Jia meets Fang Wen Yu, a writer who is the complete opposite of her and learns to find her confidence in happiness and life again

name: Poser
summary: Exploring toxic female friendship through the lens of a sexy, emotional thriller, Poser centers around two estranged, former best friends. When one of them is given a chance to live the life she's long coveted, and maybe get answers as to why they fell out years ago, she finds herself in a psychological game of revenge, betrayal, and heartbreak — ultimately altering their lives, and those around them, forever.

name: Fino all'ultimo battito
summary: Diego Mancini is an heart surgeon irreproachable that commits a crime to save his son, being extorted by mob.

name: Wakakusa Monogatari: Koisuru Shimai to Koisenu Watashi
summary: Work, love, marriage, dreams...Four sisters face the inevitable challenges of life and go through trial and error while searching for their own happiness. What will be the four different happy endings they each reach...

name: The Audacity
summary: Set inside the bubble of Silicon Valley, The Audacity takes on the warped dreams, outsized egos, and ethical lapses of the self-styled inventors of the future. In a world of jaded billionaires, psychiatrist-gurus, bio-hacked tech bros, AI labs and disillusioned teens being optimized in elite private schools, an audacious data-mining CEO strives to turn insight and influence into profit and power. The darkly comedic drama confronts reality, privacy, and the delusions fueling our ever-changing world.

name: Bloody Flower
summary: A serial killer who has the ability to cure all incurable diseases, posing a shocking question that overturns law and common sense and building viewers' anticipation.

name: «СССР. Знак качества» с Иваном Охлобыстиным
summary: The Soviet Union was not just about the hammer and sickle, the first space flights, "PEACE!LABOR!MAY!", or the arms race. For many, it was a time of youth. The best period in every person's life, when we learned to love, to be friends, to cope with defeats, not to lose our heads from victories, and — not to worry about tomorrow… Host of the program "USSR. The "Quality Mark," the artifacts he found, as well as the witnesses of the Soviet era, will allow us to take a time travel journey and remember how the citizens of the largest country on the planet lived. Learn about the USSR in detail, in black and white and in color, with humor and seriousness — with Ivan Okhlobystin!

name: Dastaan-E-Mohabbat: Salim Anarkali
summary: Salim, a young Mughal prince falls for a courtesan named Anarkali but things become complicated after he faces opposition from Emperor Akbar, his father.

name: Лошадиная энциклопедия
summary: Thousands of years ago, a person, upon seeing a horse, was struck by its beauty, intelligence, and the structure of its back. People fell in love with it and wanted to tame it... Man achieved his goal, but only partially. The horse never loved people, and it still doesn't. This film is a look at the history of the relationship between humans and horses. It's about the main secrets of this noble animal and its greatest misfortune — its closeness to humans...

name: Laid Bare
summary: Ten men staying at a gay nude resort are slowly picked off one by one, leading to paranoia, violence, and a whole lot of bitchiness as the dwindling number of survivors turn on each other.

name: Я дождусь
summary: In the after war years from France to motherland returns a soldier with a name Sergei. Giselle his french love is moving with him too. For Giselle it is hard to get used to the lifestyle of a soviet village but she is trying as hard as she can because of her feelings for him. But on the other hand Sergei is a popular man in the village. His neighbour Klavdia is also in love with him and she is trying to destroy the marriage in any possible way. She makes Sergei fall in love with her sister Olga. Unspeakable passion is happening in the village. Which choice will Sergei make?

name: Heavy Lift
summary: The story of the engineers and mechanics behind some of the largest lifting and moving equipment in the world.

name: Дело было в Гавриловке
summary: Somewhere in the Urals, the small town of gavrilovka was lost. The old house, khrushchovkas, a squatter... Around the river and lake, wonderful places-hunting, fishing, mushrooms and berries. Here people live slowly, everyone knows each other, but even here serious passions are boiling, and why is something out of the ordinary always happening? Each episode begins with an emergency that hits residents from the TV show "Echo of Gavrilovka". And the local police Department has to investigate a variety of cases: someone drowns, someone disappears, or something supernatural happens-a Ghost appears in the town. And although the crimes are sometimes very clever, the police get to the bottom of it.

name: The Lightbulb Moment
summary: Uncover the extraordinary origins of "ordinary" things – and the moments of inspiration that made them possible.

name: Wild Animal Rescue
summary: Wild Animal Rescue follows international animal welfare organization, Four Paws, on daring and sometimes dangerous rescue missions to give animals a better life.

previousepisode.name: Sanctuary for Wildlife in the Middle East and the Rhino Crisis

name: Blueprint for Disaster
summary: When tragedy strikes, the first question on the public's mind is: how and why could that have happened? Sometimes the smallest oversight can lead to the greatest of disasters. Problems often arise from the most unlikely source and the seemingly smallest problem can turn into a massive catastrophe. Whatever the cause, these stories make headlines and the world looks on in horror wondering what went wrong.

name: Полиция Хоккайдо. Русский отдел
summary: The Russian police department is fighting organized crime in Japan. Major of the Sakhalin prosecutor's office, Alexandra Shevchuk, works in partnership with a Hokkaido police officer — Takuya Minamoto. They solve crimes related to the activities of the Russian mafia on the Japanese islands. Soon, Alexandra and Takuya's working relationship develops into romantic feelings.

name: Медвежья хватка
summary: In the center of the plot is a young man named Mikhail, who lives in one of the cities located on the territory of the Altai Territory. One day he has to leave his native land and go to Moscow in order to bring his sister Anna a rather large amount of money needed for an urgent surgical operation.

name: Ивановы
summary: Peter is the father of spoiled children and works a boring job,. On top of that, he has to deal with his sister Olga's hopeless relationship. When their absent father unexpectedly shows up, life seems to transform.

name: Kem's
summary: In each episode, two teams of 2 celebrities challenge each other in a game of Kemps. The goal is simple: assemble 4 identical cards and signal it to your partner without being noticed by the other team!

previousepisode.name: Laura Felpin, Felix Moati, Sophie-Marie Larroy, Alice Moitié

name: Fierce & Furious Academy
summary: Rising Star Academy is a dream school for kids hoping to enter the entertainment industry. Its curriculum emphasises music and performance and gives students a foothold in the industry. Their students are elite; this year, only twenty new students are admitted from thousands.

name: Becoming Elephant: The Orphans Of Reteti
summary:
Becoming Elephant: The Orphans of Reteti is set in the wild north of Kenya, where a groundbreaking blueprint in conservation is under way. This touching documentary series follows the remarkable journey of orphaned elephants at Reteti Elephant Sanctuary, the first community-owned and -operated elephant sanctuary in Africa.

These young elephants, rescued after losing their mothers to accidents, drought, or human-wildlife violence, are raised by Samburu men and women who care for them as their own. They nurture these young elephants with patience, care, and deep ancestral knowledge to get them back on their feet and ready for life in the wild.

From tiny calves taking their first bottles from their human carers, to adolescents preparing for release, this series captures the elephants' intimate moments of struggle, healing, and transformation. It also shows how local community members are creating a unique, thoughtful new model of conservation from the ground up.

name: Jamie's Feasts for a Fiver
summary: Jamie Oliver shows us how to deliver big, beautiful flavour without the hefty price tag.

name: The Beauty Queen and the Catfish
summary: When a small-town beauty queen suspects the doctor she has been messaging is not who he says he is, she turns detective to catch one of the UK's most prolific catfish.

name: The Showjumper Murder
summary: When Northern Irish showjumper Katie Simpson died unexpectedly in August 2020, the horse community accepted that she had taken her own life. However, a local journalist questioned the official conclusion revealing how a secret investigation ended in a high-stakes murder trial.

name: Fabrizio Corona: Io sono notizia
summary: This documentary series explores the life and career of paparazzi king Fabrizio Corona, reflecting Italy's recent history of scandals and social change.

name: Мамник
summary:
In the village of Vrakola, nestled in the Tran region, mysterious and unexplainable events unfold. People are found murdered in bizarre ways, while others wake up with peculiar marks on their bodies resembling bird claw prints. A sinister, inhuman force seems to have descended upon the village.

Amid the chaos, Emil Slavov, a resident of a nursing home, teams up with border officers Bozhana Gorneva and her colleague Mitko to investigate these chilling occurrences. Their search uncovers long-buried secrets from the past and brings them face-to-face with the "Mamnik" – a demonic bird from Bulgarian folklore.

As the darkness deepens, Emil's son, Delyan Slavov, mysteriously vanishes. Joining the fight against the evil are Dana, a vrazhalitsa with mystical knowledge, and Lazar Karaivanov, a platenik – a resurrected soul with unfinished business in the mortal world.

Prepare to delve into a world of folklore, mystery, and suspense in this gripping tale of the supernatural!

name: Taskaree: The Smuggler's Web
summary: A dedicated customs officer and his team take on a notorious smuggler leading a powerful syndicate, but unexpected obstacles threaten their mission.

name: If Only You Weren't the One
Counsels
summary: Young lawyers navigate the intense demands of their early careers while dealing with personal dramas and relationships, all during a pivotal time in their professional development.

name: Handsome Devil: Charming Killer
summary: Handsome Devil: Charming Killer unravels the story of how Wade Wilson, a 25-year-old Florida man arrested for the brutal murders of two women, unexpectedly became a social media fixation. Wilson's mugshot ignited an online frenzy among people drawn to his "bad boy" bravado, surprising tattoos and seductive smile. Dubbed as the "Deadpool Killer," he became an object of fascination for online fans, even as the details of his crimes grew more disturbing.  Through police bodycam footage and chilling first-hand accounts from those closest to the case, the series explores how a man who committed unimaginable violence ended up with a devoted online following.

name: Accidental Tourist
summary: Following the recent success of Accidental Tourist, ITV has commissioned a further three more specials which will see Stephen Mulhern enlist the help of long time friends Ant and Dec in a bid toface more of his fears and phobias in some exciting new destinations.

name: Shaun Tan's Tales from Outer Suburbia
summary: Klara and Pim move to the suburbs—but strange encounters hint their new home holds unexpected secrets.

name: I Suck At Girls
summary: Three awkward high school sophomores stumble through the messy world of teenage romance and identity, learning that sucking at girls is just part of growing up.
